title: Complete monotonicity or log-convexity of a Mittag-Leffler expression
statement:
Let $0<\alpha\leq\frac{1}{2}$ and define

$$
f(t)=\left|E_{2\alpha,1}(-t)\right|^2+t\left|E_{2\alpha,1+\alpha}(-t)\right|^2.
$$

Here $E_{\rho,\beta}$ denotes the Mittag-Leffler function with parameters $\rho$ and $\beta$. **Complete-monotonicity conjecture.** The function $f(t)$ is completely monotone, or at least log-convex, for $t>0$. This property is proposed as the key ingredient for proving a logarithmic convexity estimate for time-fractional Schrödinger equations; no resolution is supplied, so the conjecture remains open.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.03600

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2025).
source_name: S. E. Chorfi, F. Et-tahri, L. Maniar and M. Yamamoto, “Forward and backward problems for abstract time-fractional Schrödinger equations”, arXiv:2510.03600 (2025).
